purpose: This package provides a small wrapper around Roblox data stores and two services that choose the scope and lifetime of that wrapper for you.
description: This package provides a small wrapper around Roblox data stores and two services that choose the scope and lifetime of that wrapper for you.

DataStore.luau.description: Wraps one key in a Roblox DataStore with cached reads, staged writes, atomic saves, and optional autosaving. This is the server-state datastore used by [GameDataStoreService] and Public entry points include `DataStore.new`, `DataStore.Store`, `DataStore.Load`, `DataStore.LoadAll`, `DataStore.Save`, `DataStore.Sync`, `DataStore.SetAutoSaveTimeSeconds`, `DataStore.GetAutoSaveTimeSeconds`.

DataStorePromises.luau.description: Promise wrappers for Roblox DataStore operations. Public entry points include `DataStorePromises.isDataStore`, `DataStorePromises.promiseDataStore`, `DataStorePromises.getAsync`, `DataStorePromises.updateAsync`.

GameDataStoreService.luau.description: Provides a frequently synchronized datastore for game-wide server state. Public entry points include `GameDataStoreService.Init`, `GameDataStoreService.SetRobloxDataStore`, `GameDataStoreService.PromiseDataStore`, `GameDataStoreService.SetDataStoreKey`, `GameDataStoreService.Destroy`.

PrivateServerDataStoreService.luau.description: Provides server state keyed to the current private or reserved server. Public servers share the fallback key "main". Public entry points include `PrivateServerDataStoreService.Init`, `PrivateServerDataStoreService.PromiseDataStore`, `PrivateServerDataStoreService.PromiseDataStoreForKey`, `PrivateServerDataStoreService.SetCustomKey`, `PrivateServerDataStoreService.SetRobloxDataStore`,…
